summary: Converts an image toward greyscale using selectable RGB and alpha channel conversion methods.

key_params.name: mono
key_params.note: Amount of greyscale conversion, 0 full color to 1 full greyscale

key_params.name: rgb
key_params.note: luminance, rgba channels, rgbaverage, or average source for RGB

key_params.name: alpha
key_params.note: luminance, rgba channels, rgbaverage, or average source for alpha

common_gotchas: mono=0 is full color, while mono=1 is full greyscale.
The alpha menu is independent from the RGB menu and can change transparency unexpectedly.
Using alpha as the RGB source can flatten the image if alpha is constant.
RGBA Average uses the official token average, not rgbaaverage.
key_concepts: Converts image colors toward greyscale while preserving a blend amount through mono.
RGB conversion and alpha conversion have separate source menus.
Conversion sources include luminance, individual channels, RGB average, and RGBA average.
mono=0 leaves full color and mono=1 produces full greyscale.
The operator supports 3D Textures and 2D Texture Arrays.
